subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

GMP : IKS :: FOL : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

Logic : 

 
• **First letter** → (2) is added in the position value.
 
• **Second letter ****→** (2) is subtracted from the position value.
 
• **Third letter** → (3) is added in the position value.

So,

 
• GMP : IKS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f80be292faf0c7904094aa7e8c7920c33c41c73ea76975d111e88ecf666251f.png] ​

​Similarly,

 
• FOL : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad6ac4adc81569647ee3ea055119eca0a00ae7e12f1c4d35e0839ea8cce24138.png] ​

​Hence, **"HMO"** is the correct answer.

9c:T98
